initial_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND mobility >= 50
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User requires the building to be near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), the building should score at or above this level for transport accessibility. No other service category was requested; education proximity is not explicitly asked for, so it is not activated.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-child capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user. Other requirements (180 sqm gross floor area, 14 children, integration with a kindergarten in Turin, proximity to public transport) are not energy-efficiency filters and were not included.
